newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-CHINA'S YE SAILS THROUGH AT WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-CHINA'S YE SAILS THROUGH AT WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Ye Zhaoying, the world number one from China, took just 17 minutes to beat Sandra Dimbour of France in the first round of the world badminton championships on Tuesday.
The All-England champion, who helped her country take the Sudirman Cup in the team championships last week, won 11-4 11-2.
She now meets Commonwealth Games champion, Lisa Campbell of Australia, in Tuesday's second round.

Ye's old rival Susi Susanti was in action later on Tuesday while in the men's event Dong Jiong of China was bidding to win his first world title, but faced stiff opposition from top Indonesians and Denmark's Olympic champion Poul-Erik Hoyer-Larsen.
